verdict.rationale: SumUp documents in-person card acceptance through physical readers (Solo, Go) and Tap to Pay on a compatible phone without a separate reader. That covers the end state of the story, taking in-person payments. However, nothing in the evidence describes the merchant sign-up and approval flow, how long approval takes, or ordering hardware from a dashboard. Missing for 10: documented sign-up and approval process and timeline, dashboard hardware ordering, evidence of same-week time-to-first-payment, independent corroboration.
